visage_silent_as_the_grave.name: Silent as the Grave
visage_silent_as_the_grave.description: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.
visage_silent_as_the_grave.scepter_description: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
visage_silent_as_the_grave.lore: The denizens of the mortal realm are blind to the subtle purpose of those who carry out the will of the afterlife.

visage_grave_chill.name: Grave Chill
visage_grave_chill.description: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
visage_grave_chill.lore: The warmth of sunlight has never reached the dark and frigid corridors of the Narrow Maze.
visage_grave_chill.note0: The effects on Visage and the target can be dispelled independently.
visage_grave_chill.note1: The amount of speed gained is independent of the amount stolen.
visage_grave_chill.note2: Familiars within %radius% radius of their owner also gain the bonuses from this ability.

visage_soul_assumption.name: Soul Assumption
visage_soul_assumption.description: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
visage_soul_assumption.facet_visage_gold_assumption: Soul Assumption kills give %bonus_soul_charge_gold% gold per soul charge, up to %bonus_gold_max_tooltip% gold. Reduced gold from creeps. Enemy heroes killed within %gold_grace_period_hero%s of being affected by Soul Assumption also give gold.
visage_soul_assumption.lore: The gathered souls of the dead burst forth to claim another for their flock.
visage_soul_assumption.note0: Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
visage_soul_assumption.soul_charge_gold: BONUS GOLD PER CHARGE PER KILL:

visage_gravekeepers_cloak.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.description:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.shard_description: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.lore: The Familiar's sturdy scales possess both the qualities of stone and spirit, rendering it nearly impervious to blade and spell alike.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note0: Taking at least the minimum damage from another player removes one layer.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note1: Familiars within %radius% radius receive the same protection from Gravekeeper's Cloak as their owner.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note2: Gaining new layers is disabled by Break.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note3: Existing layers are not disabled by Break.

visage_summon_familiars.name: Summon Familiars
visage_summon_familiars.description: Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.\n\nThe ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.facet_visage_faithful_followers:
Familiars will automatically attack the target Visage tried to attack last, and will return if that target is out of Visage's attack range, or Visage issues the cancel current action or hold position commands.

The ability can be toggled to the Auto-Cast state to command the Familiars to return to Visage and not leave his side until the state has been disabled.
visage_summon_familiars.recall_description: Recall this familiar to Visage after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.facet_visage_sepulchre: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.facet_visage_gold_assumption: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.lore: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's servants tirelessly watch over his domain.
visage_summon_familiars.note0: Casting this ability replaces existing Familiars with new ones.
visage_summon_familiars.note1: Familiars near the hero receive the same protection from Gravekeeper's Cloak as their owner.
visage_summon_familiars.stone_form_description:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After %stone_duration% seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.
visage_summon_familiars.recall_custom_description: Recall this familiar to Visage after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
